basis.clv_proxy: ASSUMED: monthly_revenue x assumed_months; revenue not margin; not a survival-based or true CLV
basis.revenue_at_risk_monthly: DERIVED: risk_score x monthly_revenue; risk-weighted recurring revenue, no time horizon implied
basis.revenue_to_date: OBSERVED: TotalCharges as reported (0.0 where never billed)

observed_note: Label-based, for comparison only. Equals the risk-weighted total only if the model is well calibrated, and scoring the training file is in-sample.
